title: Grand Canyon Sedona Oak Creek Canyon Shared Tour from Scottsdale
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of Arizona on a full-day adventure that takes you to the Grand Canyon and Sedona. Travel through the captivating landscapes of the Sonoran Desert and Northern Arizona, stopping at iconic viewpoints of the Grand Canyon South Rim. Explore the historic Hopi House to learn about Indigenous cultures and browse authentic arts and crafts. In Sedona, enjoy free time to explore local shops or take in the vibrant red rock scenery. The tour also includes a visit to picturesque Oak Creek Canyon, offering spectacular sights perfect for photography. This comprehensive tour is ideal for newcomers and returning visitors alike, showcasing the best of the American Southwest in one day.

- Full-day tour from Scottsdale to the Grand Canyon and Sedona
- Explore the Grand Canyon South Rim and visit Hopi House
- Free time in Sedona to shop and enjoy breathtaking views
- Scenic stops at Oak Creek Canyon for photography opportunities
